name: Logical Equivalence Obfuscation
description: I replaced the direct "impossible to assign to two vessels" condition with a logically equivalent set of structural properties: 1) at least one prohibited pair exists, and 2) any two materials in the set have identical prohibition status with the third. This mathematically forces the configuration to be a triangle, but requires multi-step deductive reasoning to realize it. Models that rely on pattern-matching the Pigeonhole Principle will fail to recognize the triangle and will likely fall back to a literal $O(n^3)$ simulation which TLEs.
